# Stage12 quarry immutable baseline

`before-stage12.json` and `history-before.json` were captured once from exact master d7b9fdf6696c05e53012605b77200a5ba7389197 / tree259267c90b40f03127d7fbe1a5d3b5960917aad4, before production changes. Capture refuses overwrite and checks raw campaign against its runtime projection. They are historical evidence, never regenerated to approve current output.

The legal representative entry is independently rebuilt by `tests/stage12-quarry-entry-helper.mjs` using campaign first-clear/recruit reward logic through11: XP23502/Lv11,23 earned, rank1/four-slot, six ordinary stats, no extra passive. See `game/docs/STAGE12_QUARRY_REDESIGN.md` for scope and remaining gates.
